skill.name: docker-helper
skill.description: Generate, review, optimize, and troubleshoot Dockerfiles and Docker Compose configurations for application projects.
skill.summary: Helps create secure, efficient Dockerfiles and Docker Compose setups with troubleshooting guidance.
skill.author: CuriousLearner

security_audit.summary: The skill is primarily Docker instructional content and most static command findings are false positives from Markdown code fences. Real issues remain around examples that normalize hardcoded database credentials, sensitive .env usage, interactive shell access, and destructive Docker cleanup commands without strong safety warnings.

remediation.issue: Hardcoded database credentials appear in Compose examples.
remediation.suggestion: Replace sample passwords and full database URLs with placeholders or Docker secrets, and add guidance not to commit real credentials.

remediation.issue: Docker cleanup commands are listed without safety context.
remediation.suggestion: Add warnings before docker system prune -a and docker volume prune, and suggest reviewing affected resources before running them.

remediation.issue: Interactive container shell commands are presented as general troubleshooting steps.
remediation.suggestion: Label docker run -it and docker exec -it shell access as debug-only and advise users to avoid exposing secrets during sessions.
Clarify that .env files must stay out of images and version control, and prefer secret managers for production deployments.

content.value_statement: Container setup can be slow, insecure, and hard to debug. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code generate Dockerfiles, Compose files, and troubleshooting steps using container best practices.
actual_capabilities: Generates Dockerfile examples for Node.js, Python, and Go applications.
Creates Docker Compose patterns for multi-service web, API, database, cache, and proxy stacks.
Suggests multi-stage builds, layer caching, non-root users, and smaller base images.
Provides troubleshooting steps for startup failures, networking, volumes, and slow builds.
Recommends health checks, restart policies, logging, and production hardening practices.
limitations: Does not inspect a running Docker daemon unless the user asks the host tool to run commands.
Example credentials and service names must be replaced before production use.
Generated files still need validation against the project dependency graph and deployment target.
Some cleanup commands can remove local Docker resources if copied without review.

use_cases.title: Create a first container setup
use_cases.description: Generate a Dockerfile and Compose file for a new application with common services and health checks.

use_cases.title: Improve existing container builds
use_cases.description: Review Docker files for image size, caching, non-root execution, and security hardening opportunities.

use_cases.title: Debug local Compose failures
use_cases.description: Use structured checks for logs, networking, service readiness, volumes, and shell access during development.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Dockerfile
prompt_templates.prompt: Use docker-helper to create a Dockerfile for my project. Ask for the language, start command, port, and package manager before writing the file.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Compose stack
prompt_templates.prompt: Use docker-helper to draft a docker-compose.yml for a web app, API, database, and cache. Include networks, volumes, health checks, and clear placeholders for secrets.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize container builds
prompt_templates.prompt: Use docker-helper to review my Dockerfile for build cache, multi-stage build opportunities, image size, and non-root execution. Explain each recommended change.

prompt_templates.title: Troubleshoot production-like failures
prompt_templates.prompt: Use docker-helper to diagnose why my Compose services fail to start. Build a safe step-by-step investigation plan for logs, health checks, networking, volumes, and resource limits.

output_examples.input: Generate a Dockerfile for a Node.js API.
output_examples.output: A concise Dockerfile plan using dependency caching, a production stage, non-root user execution, exposed port, and a health check.

output_examples.input: My API cannot connect to Postgres in Docker Compose.
output: Check that both services share a network.
Use the Compose service name as the database hostname.
Confirm database readiness with a health check before the API starts.

output_examples.input: Optimize this Dockerfile for smaller images.
output_examples.output: A review that recommends multi-stage builds, narrower copy steps, cache-friendly dependency installation, and a minimal runtime image.

best_practices: Review generated commands before running them against local or shared Docker resources.
Replace sample credentials with secret management or environment-specific configuration.
Validate generated Docker and Compose files with local builds and health checks.
anti_patterns: Do not copy sample passwords or database URLs into production Compose files.
Do not run Docker cleanup commands without checking which images, containers, and volumes will be removed.
Do not rely on generated container files without testing service startup and networking.

faq.question: Can this skill create Dockerfiles from scratch?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides patterns for common Node.js, Python, and Go applications, then adapts them to project details.

faq.question: Does it support Docker Compose?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes examples for multi-service stacks with networks, volumes, health checks, and service dependencies.

faq.question: Will it run Docker commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides command guidance. Any host command execution depends on the AI tool and user approval.

faq.question: Is it safe for production secrets?
faq.answer: Use caution. The skill includes sample credentials, so users must replace them with proper secret management.

faq.question: Can it reduce image size?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends multi-stage builds, cache-friendly layers, minimal base images, and cleanup in the same layer.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
